fixture.line: Public configuration fixture with ordinary text and no sensitive values.
fixture.index: all 1000 files newly staged; config/targets.dotfile empty and untracked

method.timing: time.perf_counter around fresh /usr/bin/time -l CLI subprocess; one warmup then three sequential samples per implementation/scope
method.scope: CLI startup, scanning and Git subprocesses included; --no-canaries; warm OS page cache
method.rss: maximum resident set size reported by macOS /usr/bin/time -l, bytes; maximum sample reported below
method.git_count: separate instrumented invocation with shell wrapper logging each Git exec; wrapper excluded from all timed/RSS invocations
method.notes: Synthetic nonsecret data; measurements on one machine, no universal performance threshold.

reproduce.fixture: Create the files described by fixture under a fresh Git repository; git add shared; keep config/targets.dotfile untracked. Set DOTFILE_ROOT to fixture root, HOME to empty home, XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/.config and NO_COLOR=1.
reproduce.python: git archive python_reference_commit scripts/python/src/tools into a separate directory, add its .git directory, set PYTHONPATH to extracted scripts/python/src; run scripts/python/.venv/bin/python -c "from tools.dotfile.cli import run;run()" secret scan --no-canaries [--staged]
reproduce.sampling: Run each command once to warm up, then three fresh timed subprocesses, report median wall duration and maximum peak RSS; Git wrapper only in separate count run.
